subject: [PATCH v3 2/2] x86/early_printk: Add earlyprintk=tdx to drive the UART with TDVMCALLs

reviews.author: Verma, L
reviews.summary:
Reviewer noted that prototype declarations in asm/tdx.h require __noendbr annotations to match the function implementations, which have already been annotated.

The reviewer suggested that the accessors for serial I/O should be declared outside the #ifdef TDX block in tdx.c and annotated there, instead of being defined inside the block.
reviews.raw_body:
Hi Kiryl,

Thanks - that makes sense and the patch looks good. I think the
prototype declarations in asm/tdx.h (see below) also need __noendbr
annotations?


<snip>

---

.. Should these also be:

+__noendbr unsigned int tdx_serial_in(unsigned long addr, int offset);
+__noendbr void tdx_serial_out(unsigned long addr, int offset, int value);

2026-10-02.patch_summary: This patch modifies the x86 early_printk functionality to support TDX (Trusted Domain eXtensions) guests by allowing the UART to be driven using TDVMCALLs instead of IN/OUT instructions, which can result in a #VE exception. The patch introduces new accessors for serial I/O operations and removes unnecessary wrappers. It also updates the tdx.c file to provide these accessors with the correct signature. The changes are designed to work both with and without TDX enabled.
